title: Local chat sessions
responsibility: Keeps bounded owner conversations, validates bridge operations and prevents a retried request from starting duplicate work.

inputs.name: ConsoleAgentService.call.method
inputs.description: Selects a web-session read or an allowed validated bridge operation. The special reads are events and registry; other values must be in the service allowlist.

inputs.name: ConsoleAgentService.call.input
inputs.description: Payload for the selected read or bridge channel, parsed by IpcRequestValidator for bridge operations. The events read coerces optional after with Number and requires a non-negative safe-integer cursor.
inputs.unknownReason: The chosen channel determines the payload shape and bridge inputs are parsed before dispatch.

inputs.name: ConsoleAgentService.call.requestId
inputs.description: Used only by startRun to require a 36-character lowercase hexadecimal-or-hyphen identity and deduplicate identical serialized input; reuse with different input throws. Defaults to undefined when omitted.

inputs.name: consoleAgent.input
inputs.description: Owner-only chat request envelope. The method selects connect, disconnect, a read, or a validated bridge operation; token identifies an in-memory session, input carries the operation payload, and a string requestId is forwarded.
inputs.unknownReason: The envelope is decoded from an owner request and its fields depend on the selected method.

outputs.name: ConsoleAgentService.open
outputs.description: The local project snapshot returned by opening reportSite().root, used to initialize the chat session. Its value is forwarded from ProjectSessionService.open without reshaping.

outputs.name: ConsoleAgentService.close
outputs.description: Cancels the active run through DesktopRunService.cancelActive. The method returns undefined.

outputs.name: ConsoleAgentService.busy
outputs.description: Reports whether the project session is busy running work. It directly reflects ProjectSessionService.busy.

outputs.name: ConsoleAgentService.expired
outputs.description: Reports whether the session has been untouched for more than one hour while not busy. A busy session is never reported expired.

outputs.name: ConsoleAgentService.call
outputs.description: Resolves to the selected read result or validated bridge operation result. The events read returns buffered events, a gap flag, replay data, and the latest sequence.

outputs.name: consoleAgent
outputs.description: Resolves to the connect token and initial snapshot, null after disconnect, or the selected session operation result. Tokens are kept in the in-memory session map.

errors.name: ChatSessionError
errors.description: Thrown for invalid event cursors, unavailable operations, invalid or conflicting startRun request identities, invalid session tokens, or exhausted active-session capacity. Errors from project opening, validation, repository reads, and bridge calls are propagated without translation.

outputs.name: ConsoleAgentService.open
outputs.description: The local project snapshot returned by opening reportSite().root, used to initialize the chat session. Its value is forwarded from ProjectSessionService.open without reshaping.

errors.name: Project open failed or workspace is busy
errors.description: ProjectSessionService.open failures propagate; it throws when work is busy or pending, or another opening is already in progress.

outputs.description: Cancels the active run through DesktopRunService.cancelActive. The method returns undefined.

outputs.name: ConsoleAgentService.expired
outputs.description: Reports whether the session has been untouched for more than one hour while not busy. A busy session is never reported expired.

errors.description: Thrown for an invalid or expired token or when every retained session is active. A failed connect removes its token and rethrows the opening error; session call errors propagate.
